item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 30/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea and towards the coast of eastern Guangdong in the next couple of days, edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary gradually. It will be windy with squally showers and swells over the coast of Guangdong on Friday and over the weekend. Saola may be affected by the northeast monsoon and Tropical Cyclone Haikui thereafter, and there are still uncertainties in its track and intensity. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Besides, Haikui will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days.
